_about: What is derived and what is flagged in this vocabulary. validated_by stays empty until a person who knows the domain confirms the rule.

rules.why: Documents name the engagement a meeting concerned, but questions about a client need every meeting with that client in one place, including general relationship meetings.
rules.validated_by: Chiheb Dkhil, 2026-11-03 (walked through in the ontology interview)

then.flag: this interaction names neither an engagement nor a client: say which client it was with

rules.why: Every fact must trace to the right client. An interaction may concern several engagements or the client alone, so a required link cannot say this, and this rule does.
rules.validated_by: Chiheb Dkhil, 2026-11-03 (walked through in the ontology interview)

then.flag: this open item is past its due date

rules.why: An overdue item nobody chases is a promise being quietly broken.
rules.validated_by: Chiheb Dkhil, 2026-11-03 (walked through in the ontology interview)

then.flag: this decision is past the date it was needed by

rules.why: A late decision on the critical path moves everything after it.
rules.validated_by: Chiheb Dkhil, 2026-11-03 (walked through in the ontology interview)

then.flag: this decision is recorded as made but says nothing about why

rules.why: A decision with no reason gets argued again.
rules.validated_by: Chiheb Dkhil, 2026-11-03 (walked through in the ontology interview)

rules.why: A risk nobody owns is a risk nobody is mitigating.
rules.validated_by: Chiheb Dkhil, 2026-11-03 (walked through in the ontology interview)

then.flag: this promise contradicts the scope: raise it with the client before they find it

rules.why: A promise the contract excludes is the most urgent gap to close.
rules.validated_by: Chiheb Dkhil, 2026-11-03 (walked through in the ontology interview)
